article.headline: One Designer's Curated Directory for the AI Skills Explosion
article.lede: Michał Greń, a Polish product designer, grew tired of saving links to AI agent tools across ten different services. His solution is a single curated page — titled Hotkeys — cataloguing every *Claude Code skill* a designer might plausibly need, sorted by discipline.
article.body:
The site takes its structural cue from shortcuts.design, a longstanding designer reference card for keyboard shortcuts. Where that resource is static, Hotkeys is a living directory with categories — Hot Picks, Latest, Accessibility, Design, Dev, Motion — that index installable *Agent Skills*. That term refers to a lightweight open format, originally created by **Anthropic** and standardized at agentskills.io, for packaging specialized knowledge into portable, version-controlled folders. Each skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md file with metadata and instructions; agents load only the name and description at startup, pulling the full contents on demand when a task triggers the skill — a pattern called *progressive disclosure* that keeps the agent's working context lean.

The install command is stripped to its essentials: `npx claude skills add <name>` drops a skill into a Claude Code project in one step. Two entries the site highlights illustrate the range. The *Figma Designer* skill, published in Anthropic's official skills repository, orients Claude toward thinking like a senior designer — in components, *auto-layout*, spacing tokens, and *design systems* — before generating a single line of code. **Figma (FIG)**, the design platform whose components and tokens the skill is built to understand, completed its own IPO in July 2025. The *Theme Factory* skill ships ten pre-built visual themes — each with a coordinated color palette and font pairing — ready to apply to any artifact Claude creates: slides, documents, landing pages.

Since its release as an open standard, the Agent Skills format has been adopted by more than 35 platforms spanning competing AI coding agents and IDE extensions, meaning a skill built once can travel across whatever tools a designer or developer happens to prefer. Anthropic's own skills repository has accumulated more than 129,000 GitHub stars, a rough proxy for how quickly the format spread.

Greń's frustration — links scattered across social bookmarks, notes apps, and browser tabs — is the mundane origin of most useful aggregators. What his curation reveals is more interesting: the landscape of AI tooling for designers has fragmented fast enough to need its own librarian.

concepts.definition: A lightweight open format for extending AI agents with portable expertise. At its core, a skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with metadata and instructions, plus optional scripts, templates, and reference materials. The format is cross-platform — a skill built for one agent can run on any compatible tool.

Anthropic's terminal-based AI coding agent, capable of reading, writing, and executing code across an entire project. It runs directly in the developer's environment and can be extended with Agent Skills for specialized domain knowledge.

In the Agent Skills context, the practice of loading only a skill's name and description at agent startup — roughly 100 tokens per skill — and pulling the full instructions and resources only when a task activates the skill. Keeps the agent's context window lean when many skills are installed.

A Figma feature that makes frames dynamically resize and reposition their contents based on rules — padding, spacing, direction — rather than fixed pixel coordinates. Essential to building components that adapt gracefully to different content lengths and screen sizes.

A shared library of reusable UI components, visual tokens (colors, spacing, typography), and usage guidelines that keeps a product consistent at scale. Large teams maintain them so designers and engineers build from a single source of truth.

Named variables that encode raw design decisions — a specific color hex, a spacing multiple, a font size — in a form that code can consume directly. Tokens let a design system's values propagate automatically across web, iOS, and Android from one source.

A Node.js tool runner that executes a package from the npm registry without requiring a prior global install. In the Agent Skills context, `npx claude skills add <name>` fetches and installs a skill into the current project in a single command.

repos.summary: Anthropic's official repository of Agent Skills for Claude Code. Contains skills spanning design, development, document generation, and productivity — including Theme Factory and Figma Designer. Has accumulated more than 129,000 GitHub stars since launch.

The open-standard specification and governance repository for the Agent Skills format. Defines the SKILL.md structure, progressive disclosure model, and compatibility requirements for any platform that wants to support installable skills.

ticker_fig.name: Figma, Inc.
ticker_fig.blurb: Figma, Inc. develops and sells a collaborative, browser-based platform for designing, prototyping, and building digital experiences. Its offerings include Figma Design for team-based design and prototyping, Dev Mode for translating designs into code, and FigJam for brainstorming and alignment. The company went public on July 31, 2025, and is listed on the NYSE under the ticker FIG.
